# Jupiter Power Wash

> Family-owned power washing company in Jupiter, Florida. Single-story home exteriors (stucco walls, hurricane shutters, windows and doors), concrete and brick-paver driveways, patios, pool decks, sidewalks, and Saturday solar panel cleaning for single-story homes. Two simple prices: $300 half day, $550 full day. Customers text a photo and get told up front which one it is. Exterior car washing is separate: $25 for one exterior wash, or $99 a month for unlimited exterior washes.

- Phone (call or text): 561-600-9274 (561-600-WASH)
- Email: wash@jupiterpowerwash.com
- Address: 1609 Berkshire Ave, Jupiter, FL 33469
- Website: https://jupiterpowerwash.com
- Hours: Monday-Saturday 8am-6pm. Closed Sunday.
- Service area: Jupiter, Tequesta, Palm Beach Gardens, Juno Beach (Florida)

## Pricing

- Power washing, half day, full service: $300
- Power washing, full day, full service: $550
- No surprise add-ons. Free estimates: text a photo of what needs cleaning plus the street address to 561-600-9274 (561-600-WASH).
- Exterior car wash, one exterior wash: $25
- Exterior car wash, monthly: $99 a month for unlimited exterior washes
- Exterior car wash is at the customer's home, or at 1609 Berkshire Ave, Jupiter, FL 33469. At the shop: pull into the driveway and beep. Same published hours: Monday-Saturday 8am-6pm. Closed Sunday.
- No online payment. Call, text, or email to set up a car wash.
- Solar panel cleaning, one-time: $995 flat (full day, two-person crew, full top coverage)
- Solar panel cleaning yearly plan: $1,795 per year for 2 cleanings (saves $195)
- Payment on the day of the power-washing job: cash, check or card. Referral code JUPFRIEND50: $50 off for the customer and the friend they refer.

## Job photographs

- Two still photographs are published from jobs: a technician washing an octagon paver driveway at sunset outside a single-story home, and a close-up of octagon concrete pavers with a brick border beside a lawn.
- The paver close-up is a detail of the surface. It is not a before-and-after of a wash.
- The top hero image is a separately credited photograph and is not one of these job photographs.

## Jup Wash soap dishes

- Three photographs, no price, and no online purchase. Ask by calling or texting 561-600-9274 or emailing wash@jupiterpowerwash.com.
- Green wave, shown in two pieces: the insert lifted off the slotted base.
- Beige pebble appearance, shown as a full dish.
- Clear wave, mint appearance, shown as a full dish.
- Those words describe how the photographs look. They are not material names or product codes.

## Solar panel cleaning

- Single-story homes only, metal or shingle roofs. No two-story homes.
- Saturdays only. White-glove service.
- Done by hand: pre-soak, hand wash, hand wipe, after-clean treatment.
- Recommended every 6-12 months in Florida: dust, pollen, salt air and bird droppings form a film that blocks sunlight, and rain does not wash it off.

## How we work

- Cleaners: Simple Green Oxy Solve House & Siding (EPA Safer Choice certified, biodegradable) for stucco, shutters, windows and doors; Simple Green Oxy Solve Concrete & Driveway for driveways, pavers and pool decks; a full fresh-water rinse for coastal salt film. Simple Green on every job. Plants are soaked before and rinsed after. Stubborn black mildew may need a stronger diluted soft-wash treatment; the customer is told first.
- House washing (stucco, shutters, windows, doors) is for single-story homes only. No two-story houses.
- Electric pressure washers: quiet, no exhaust fumes at the home. We use an outdoor electrical outlet, or bring our own generator.
- No online booking: call, text, or use the contact form on the website.
- The website chat answers at any hour and cannot book a job. Shop phone hours remain Monday-Saturday 8am-6pm. Closed Sunday. Chat text is kept 30 days to review unfinished questions and is not public.
